text: 65分、Seabrook Townは2-1とリードを追いかけるために戦術を大胆にチェンジしました。彼らはより前線で激しくプレッシャーをかけ、攻撃も素早く直接的に仕掛けるように変えましたが、実はチャンスの数や期待ゴール（xG）は少し減ってしまいました。ボールを持つ場所も減り、Harbour Cityの粘り強い守備に手こずっている様子です[#1361]。

- Seabrook Town increased press intensity from 0.66 to 0.84 and directness from 0.42 to 0.57 at 65' to chase the game [#1361].  
- Seabrook Town’s xG decreased slightly from 0.56 before the change to 0.47 after the change in the next 15 minutes [#1361].  
- Field tilt for Seabrook Town dropped from 70.7% before to 45.7% after the tactical change [#1361].  
- Seabrook Town’s box touches decreased from 12 to 7 after pressing higher and playing more direct [#1361].  
- Score remained 2-1 in favor of Harbour City after Seabrook Town’s tactical shift at 65' [#1361].

- Seabrook Town, trailing 2-1 at 65 minutes, adjusted their tactics to press higher up the pitch and play more direct to chase the game, reflecting a shift from their initial style of wide, crossing play to a more aggressive, forward approach [#1361].
- This tactical change involved increasing pressing intensity (press from 0.66 to 0.84), raising their defensive line (line_height from 0.6 to 0.72), and boosting directness in attack (directness from 0.42 to 0.57), signaling a move to force turnovers earlier and create quicker attacking transitions under coach Mara Lindholm in their 3-4-3 formation [#1361].
- Despite the increased pressing and more direct style, Seabrook Town's expected goals (xG) and shots slightly decreased after the change (xG 0.56 to 0.47, shots 5 to 4), suggesting the shift may have disrupted their usual wide crossing play pattern and reduced effective build-up chances against Harbour City's 4-2-3-1 patient short passing style led by Tomasz Rhee [#1361].
- The reduction in field tilt (possession in attacking areas) from 70.7% before to 45.7% after the change indicates Seabrook struggled to maintain territorial dominance despite pressing higher, perhaps due to Harbour City’s compact defensive setup and control with short passing in midfield [#1361].
